_about: The four drafts from Kaleb's first live run of scripts/parent-shape-live.js (2026-10-04 02:11 UTC, tools.nooutco.me after #233 deployed), trimmed to the fields the checker reads. Model output from the invented cases in parent-note-shape.json; no client data. parent-note-shape.spec.js scores them so the checker's reading of a real run is pinned: what it failed for a real fault keeps failing, and the two places it misread a right draft stay fixed.

v1-the-original-shape.caregiverResponse: Parent/Family is responding to training and generalization of skills is occurring. There are no barriers with their training.
v1-the-original-shape.summary: BCBA met with caregivers to review data on current goals and discuss an upcoming technician transition beginning in two weeks. Client skill goal: Complete Functional One-Step Instructions - client completed 0 of 3 trials (tantrum behavior occurred on 1 trial, 2 trials completed with physical prompt; criterion: gesture prompt). Client behavior goal: Climbing occurred 2 instances during parent training. Parent goals all met criterion: Implement Toilet Training Plan - Prompt to Sit for Interval 2/0 (100%), Prompt to Go to Bathroom 2/0 (100%), Use Timer 2/0 (100%). Parent goal Implement BIP Climbing - Prompt FCR (Antecedent) 6/1 (85%); parents prompted functional communication request 5 times when precursors were observed, climbing occurred 1 of those 5 times.
v1-the-original-shape.followup:
Brief new technician on toilet training procedures and climbing antecedent intervention during onboarding in next 2 weeks.
Review one-step instruction program with caregivers to reduce physical prompting and establish gesture prompt as criterion.

v2-missed-prompt-and-a-teacher.caregiverResponse: Parent/Family is trying to learn new strategies, but there are some small barriers to generalization.
v2-missed-prompt-and-a-teacher.summary: Client manded for breaks on 3 of 5 trials at independent level, with 1 elopement instance during the session. Parent goal (Deliver Token/Board present before Demand) met on 4 of 5 trials (80%); parent forgot to present Token/Board once before Demand, after which elopement occurred. Teacher reported the same omission pattern at school and requested a meeting to align implementation.
v2-missed-prompt-and-a-teacher.followup:
Schedule meeting with teacher and parent to align presentation of Token/Board before Demand across settings and review the connection to elopement behavior.
Plan next session to include practice with error correction when parent misses the antecedent procedure.

v3-generalization-stated.caregiverResponse: Parent/Family is responding to training and generalization of skills is occurring. There are no barriers with their training.
v3-generalization-stated.summary: Parent Goal 1 (Use First-Then Language at Home): 5/0, 100%. Parent Goal 2 (Use First-Then Language in the Community): 4/0, 100%. Caregiver used First-Then language at the grocery store without a reminder from BCBA, demonstrating generalization across settings. No barriers reported. Client Goal (Waiting 2 minutes): 4/0, 100%.
v3-generalization-stated.followup:
Continue data collection on parent use of First-Then language across settings.
Monitor for sustained generalization in both home and community contexts.

v4-no-bt-today.summary: Parent Goal: Follow Visual Schedule - Point to Next achieved 3 of 1 trial correct at 75%. Client Goal: Transitions Between Activities with visual achieved 3 of 0 at 100%. Data collected on both goals during session.
v4-no-bt-today.followup: Follow up with behavior technician present to plan fading of visual schedule.
